card.name: Poverty and development statistics text
card.fires_on: Words and number pieces inside passages about poverty, development and inequality, often just before a figure or a social-welfare term. It fires on small linking words, spaces and digits in these passages.

modes.label: Numbers in poverty figures
modes.description: Digits or spaces just before a statistic about poverty or health rates.

modes.label: Linking words in development text
modes.description: Short words like an, the, in, of before terms about growth, welfare or human development.
modes.example: Nepal is still a poor country with<< an>> HDI value for 201

card.plain: It lights up in writing about poverty and human development, on small words and digits before figures or social terms.
